column1: # PermitBridge live status baseline (www). Columns: expected_status<TAB>path<TAB>redirect_target (308 only).
# Updated 2026-11-07: /transfer/nurse/california/texas moved 308->410 (its target was never published).

column2: ' read s p t; do r=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}' "https://www.getpermitbridge.com$p"); [ "$r" != "$s ${t}" ] && [ "$r" != "$s " ] && echo "DIFF want=$s $t got=$r $p"; sleep 0.5; done; echo done
